scope: Welcome, password login and multiuser native Figma prototype

discovery.local: Manrope, Heroicons, semantic variables, wallpaper and shell reused
discovery.libraries: Search found general libraries with unrelated tokens; build small compatible Auth family on local Aegis tokens

acceptance: Editable layers and reusable component instances
Local passwords, first admin, separate initial login
No guest, biometric, cloud or recovery promises
No app content behind unauthenticated surfaces
validation: PASS: 51 native editable screens; 96 valid navigation links; no content overflows, raster violations or leftover placeholders. All17 desktop panels and17 phone screens visually reviewed; shared tablet panel geometry and tablet shell reviewed. Latest affected states rechecked after fixes.
prototype: Clickable example states with prefilled demonstration data; no live account operations.

loginRevision.style: Compact profile and password directly on softened wallpaper; no window, sidebar, app header or explanatory copy
loginRevision.validation: 21 screens: no overflows, invalid links, window/sidebar remnants. Desktop login, picker and error reviewed; all7 phone states and tablet example visually passed.

wizardRevision.style: Essential labels and actions; no marketing paragraphs or redundant explanations
wizardRevision.validation: 12 screens: no overflows; all 18 navigation links preserved and valid. All four desktop panels and four phone screens visually passed; tablet shell visually passed.
